name: ATEX 2014/34/EU
fullName: ATEX Directive 2014/34/EU — Equipment for Explosive Atmospheres
description: The ATEX directive is the mandatory European Union standard for equipment intended for use in potentially explosive atmospheres. All our explosion-proof housings are certified under Annex III (Type Examination) and Annex VII (Production Quality Assurance) of directive 2014/34/EU.

name: IECEx
fullName: IECEx System for Certification to Standards Relating to Equipment for Use in Explosive Atmospheres
description: IECEx is the International Electrotechnical Commission's global certification system. It provides a single international certificate of conformity accepted in over 35 participating countries including Australia, Brazil, Canada, China, Singapore, South Korea, and South Africa — eliminating the need for multiple national certifications.

name: UL 1203
fullName: UL 1203 — Explosion-Proof and Dust-Ignition-Proof Electrical Equipment for Use in Hazardous Locations
description: UL 1203 is the North American standard for explosion-proof equipment, covering Class I Division 1 & 2 hazardous locations. Our UL-listed housings include the required NEC/CEC classification markings, enabling direct deployment in US and Canadian facilities without additional field evaluation.

name: IP68 / IP69K
description: Our IP68 rating certifies continuous submersion protection (tested at 2 meters for 72+ hours). IP69K (optional) adds protection against high-pressure, high-temperature water jets (80°C at 80-100 bar, 4 angles) — critical for CIP/SIP cleaning in food, pharmaceutical, and chemical processing environments.

technicalDetails.ip68Test: Submerged at 2m depth for 72 hours, no water ingress
technicalDetails.ip69kStandard: ISO 20653 — Road vehicles, but adopted for industrial
technicalDetails.ip69kTest: 80°C water, 80-100 bar, 100-150 mm distance, 4 angles × 30 sec
technicalDetails.sealingMethod: Silicone rubber O-ring dual-seal system, each joint independently tested
technicalDetails.testingLab: In-house pressure chamber + SGS annual verification

name: ISO 9001:2015
description: Our entire manufacturing facility operates under an ISO 9001:2015 certified quality management system. From incoming 316L raw material verification (PMI testing per heat) to final inspection dimensional reports (FAIR per AS9102), every housing is fully traceable to its material certificate and production batch.

technicalDetails.scope: Design, manufacture, and testing of stainless steel explosion-proof camera housings and marine-grade PTZ enclosures
technicalDetails.materialTraceability: PMI (Positive Material Identification) on 100% of raw material
technicalDetails.inspectionReport: FAIR (First Article Inspection Report) per AS9102 for each order
technicalDetails.dimensionalReport: CMM (Coordinate Measuring Machine) verification on critical dimensions
technicalDetails.pressureTest: Hydrostatic pressure test at 1.5× design pressure, each housing

name: ISO 14001:2015
description: ExProof Engineering Center maintains ISO 14001:2015 certification across all manufacturing operations. Stainless steel production scrap is 100% recycled through certified metal recovery. Electropolishing process wastewater is treated through a closed-loop zero-liquid-discharge system. All packaging is FSC-certified and designed for minimal material usage.

technicalDetails.scrapRecycling: 100% stainless steel scrap recycled (certified chain of custody)
technicalDetails.wastewater: Zero liquid discharge — closed-loop electropolishing effluent treatment
technicalDetails.packaging: FSC-certified, 85% recycled content, designed for reusability
technicalDetails.energy: 40% of factory power from rooftop solar PV (1.2 MW installed capacity)
technicalDetails.chemicals: REACH-compliant passivation solutions, RoHS 3 compliant components
